notes: Identity verified internally: title The Happy Personality: A Meta-Analysis of 137 Personality Traits and Subjective Well-Being; Kristina M. DeNeve and Harris Cooper (affiliation text; byline OCR reads Copper); Psychological Bulletin 1998, Vol. 124, No. 2, 197–229; DOI identifier 10.1037/0033-2909.124.2.197. Full primary meta-analysis report includes Method, Results, references and Appendix. No PDF supplied. Rotated Tables 8–12 are severely degraded in canonical text. Target ambiguity: Table 6 at p. 13 (printed p. 209) reports Neuroticism r(+)=-.22 and k=74 independent samples. These are candidates only: supplied description says negative emotionality; the paper separately lists negative emotionality and neuroticism in footnote 4 and distinguishes capitalized factors from individual traits on p. 199. On p. 216 individual neuroticism is r=−.27, a different analysis. No explicit mapping from negative emotionality to these candidate tests was established. Potential negative-emotionality trait row cannot be recovered reliably from degraded Tables 8–12 without a supplied PDF. Candidates are not promoted into core fields. Table 6 p < .01 is between-factor contrasts; Neuroticism p < .001 on p. 209 is heterogeneity, neither an established same-test p. No participant N or arithmetic derivation performed.
